mission.title: Unexpected Alliances
mission.description: Talk a wayward Zion captain out of helping Morpheus.

npc.say: Our Captain is right, Morpheus knows what he's doing.
You won't be able to convince the Captain back to Zion--'cause Morpheus is right, we've got to take the fight to the Machines!
Morpheus is right and Zion is wrong. Simple as that.
The Captain knows that Morpheus will lead us to victory. You'll see.
Talk to our Captain, Dubiago. And don't try anything funny!
Ha, you can try talking to the Captain, but it's not gonna do you any good!
Watch out--when the Captain wants to give you a piece of his mind, he really gives it to ya!

phase.briefing:
Hail, Warrior! As you know, Morpheus has been engaging in subversive activities throughout the City. Disaffected Exiles and humans, even other members of Zion, are beginning to be misled by these activities to the point where they are preparing to aid Morpheus' efforts. This will greatly endanger our tenuous truce with the Machines.
A group of these disaffected humans--a wayward Zion crew, in fact--is in your vicinity. Talk to their captain and explain to him that by giving aid to Morpheus, he will endanger us all. Speak from the heart and you will surely convince him of his error!

enter.say: {player}, please handle this mission very diplomatically. The Zion Captain Dubiago and his crew are in that building. Talk to him and describe how his aligning himself with Morpheus will endanger the Truce and all of our hard work along with it. See if you can lead him out of the building and bring him to an extraction point. Whatever you do, don't engage him or any of his crew in combat. These are our own people, after all! I'm sure you'll know just what to do.

talk.say: I believe that Morpheus is doing the right thing... but you may have a point. Let's go out to the hall and talk about this away from my crew. But no tricks!

done.say: Very good, he's willing to listen! Try to lead him away from his crew and get him to an extraction point. But be careful! His crew is really on edge.

objective.text: Talk to Dubiago away from his crew

talk.say: Yeah look, I don't know about this. I need time to think it out.

done.say: Oh no! {player}, leave the area immediately and go to our safe house nearby. Whatever you do, don't hurt Dubiago or his crew!
You're trying to trick me into going back to Zion! I thought we had a deal! You dirty b--!

objective.text: Do not kill the Captain, Dubiago

phase.briefing: I'm sending you the address of the safe house.

enter.say: The operative Ani is in that building--she will debrief you.

objective.text: Escape from the rebellious Zion crew and talk to Ani at the safe house

talk.say: What were you thinking, noob? Look, Tyndall doesn't know how deep Morpheus' influence runs among some of our Zion crews, especially with the old-timers who fought beside him in the War--those people would kill their own granny for him. Count yourself lucky that you made it out of there with your butt intact! Now get lost, and stay the heck away from those old hard-cases until this mess blows over.

mission.finish: This did not go well... but I know you did the best you could, and I'm really glad that you made it out okay. I suppose that... well, never mind. This shows just how challenging it will be to return Morpheus and his misguided followers to our fold. We must succeed, the future of Zion depends upon it!
